attributes.action: Modernise School Holidays for Moder Families
attributes.additional_details: Im a mother working full time in a professional career. Ive worked hard to built a successful life and stable future for my daughter, showing her you can be a dedicated parent whilst still having a career. But school holidays make this difficult. Our school calendar needs to reflect modern family life. Shorter holidays could reduce pressure, whilst affordable school-based camps would provide familiar, safe environment for our children when parents are working. Yet affordable holiday means a fine
attributes.background:
I want the Government to modernise school holidays for modern family life by reducing school holidays, especially summer. Moving inset days into holidays, stop travel providers doubling prices. 
Children have 92 days off school, working parent 50 days combined, doesnt add up

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action.

We're not sure exactly how you'd like the school holidays to change.

You may wish to sign the following:

Fund more school holiday clubs for children of working parents aged 5+: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/769898

Reform statutory leave so all workers have enough paid leave to truly live: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/766860

Review school absence fines & pricing practices during school holidays: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/766186
